text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's U.N. ambassador Nizar Hamdoun hopes the new head of the U.N. commission on Iraqi disarmament will cooperate with Baghdad for a closure of all weapons files.
- Ship loaded with wheat arrives at Umm Qasr.
- U.N. secretary-general says U.N. arms inspectors should stick to their technical tasks.
- May Day turns into a bloody confrontation in Turkey.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Several articles on President Saddam Hussein's birthday and his deeds in leading Iraq through difficult times.
- Efforts underway to unload ships calling on Iraq's southern port of Umm Qasr.
- Editorial criticises close cooperation between Turkey and Israel in military and other spheres.
- Article discloses new secrets on the 1941 revolution in Iraq.
